newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-TOURING SPRINGBOKS ARRIVE IN FRANCE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-TOURING SPRINGBOKS ARRIVE IN FRANCE.

text.p: World Cup holders South Africa arrived on Tuesday at the start of a five-match tour of France which will include two tests.

The 36-man touring squad, captained by Gary Teichmann, flew from Argentina where they beat the Pumas in two tests in Buenos Aires. From Paris, the Springboks flew to Brive where they meet the French Barbarians in the opening fixture on Saturday.

The Springboks, who narrowly beat France at the semifinal stage of their successful World Cup campaign last year, will then play a French selection in Lyon on November 26 before the first test in Bordeaux four days later.

After that, they face the French Students in Lille on December 3 before the second test in Paris on December 7. At the end of the French leg they move on to Wales where they play a one-off test in Cardiff on December 15.
